
```{devoirs_choices partial_change_3_two_choices}
- A phrase identifying the context-setting quantity against which a change is examined.:
    correct: false
    feedback: This describes with respect to, not partial change. In this chapter,

      while other variables are held constant.
- One component of total change, attributed to one context variable under constant conditions.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
- A collection of quantities whose values identify locations within it.:
    correct: false
    feedback: This describes space, not partial change. In this chapter, partial change
      refers to change in a primary quantity with respect to one variable while other
      variables are held constant.
- The contribution to overall change associated with varying one context-setting quantity at a time.:
    correct: true
    feedback: Correct.
- A word that signals division, with the following quantity in the denominator.:
    correct: false
    feedback: This describes per, not partial change. In this chapter, partial change
      refers to change in a primary quantity with respect to one variable while other
      variables are held constant.
```
